response.text: {"label": "protocol_misunderstanding", "reason": "The sub assumes a frame with a low stop bit still latches 3C into a pending m_axis_tvalid word, but uart_rx only flags frame_error and outputs no data (sub `384 ... rx frame_error 1`). So no word is pending when A5 arrives and overrun never fires (sub `765 ... rx busy_fall 0`, gold `230 ... rx overrun_error 1`). The gold instead holds a valid 3C word before its bad frame."}
